question: gen1's datum at this site with NO catchment radius: every control mark inside a tile we hold, assigned to a line by its own ground returns.

inputs.role: flight-line tracks; used ONLY to disambiguate a reused point_source_id, never to search or to assign

params.name: psids
params.why: the lines the site's tile is built from, per corrections.json

params.name: catchment_radius_m
params.why: it was a compute bound, not a criterion; the returns assign, and a radius silently shifted the cover mix (at Elba all 4 marks it added were urban)

params.name: collinear_sigma
params.why: how many prediction-sd two passes of one psid may sit apart and still be one line; swept, no default

columns.sigma: collinearity cut used for reused-psid disambiguation, unitless
columns.candidates: control marks of these covers inside a tile on disk, count
columns.measured: of those, marks that yielded a tie, count
columns.kept: marks the RETURNS place on one of --psids AND that survive reused-psid disambiguation, count
columns.n_lines: distinct point_source_id among the kept marks, count
columns.datum_mm: constant to ADD to gen1 at the site, mm; mean over line means; positive = gen1 reads LOW
columns.se_mm: SE of the mean over LINES, mm -- the line is the unit of replication because marks under one line share its constant
columns.max_km: farthest kept mark from the site, km

headline: no-catchment datum +45.57 +/- 18.81 mm (14 marks, 5 lines)
